translation.english_text: Newspaper News: 'Elder sister killed younger brother.'
notes: The corrected source prints this newspaper heading at the opening of scene 92. It was historically attached to scene 91; this stable added unit restores the corrected source boundary without renumbering any surviving historical unit.

The corrected source explicitly prints the court setting before the judgment. This source-proven setting was absent from the historical English layer and is restored without renumbering existing units.

translation.english_text: (The judgment is read.) Pandiyan came only after learning the news through the newspaper. The testimony of the owner of Sivasakthi Mill and the hospital watchman makes it clear that he had no connection whatsoever with the murder. It is not credible that Pandiyan committed the murder merely because there was enmity between Paranthaman and him. Therefore Pandiyan is acquitted. (Poomaalai smiles.) Poomaalai, who admits to the crime of murder, is sentenced to death.
